scope: source-level second pass on the additive native dual-mode policy, fixed body codecs, mixed predicate and guest

checks.property: strict dual-mode dispatch and immutable authority
checks.result: One 128-byte witness and one native input are required. Exact mixed or direct-exit headers select the path. The P2SH policy pins component profile, outer image and direct Exit VK; the same-tail successor copies the complete immutable tail.

Native version, input index/count, native subnetwork, zero locktime/gas, max sequence, noncoinbase input, absent input covenant, canonical witness frame and state-domain metadata are checked. Projection bytes reconstruct actual point, amounts, SPKs, output count and full payload. Output covenant absence is checked for both possible outputs.

The selected profile pins distinct fresh Spend/Output/Exit role keys and checked Pedersen parameters. The mixed guest verifies all nine proofs, exact group conservation, current indexed-NF updates and authenticated empty-slot CM appends, and journals the complete native projection.

checks.property: full-note direct exit conservation and destination
checks.result: Reserve equals actual input; remaining equals reserve minus payout minus fee with strict positive fee/payout bounds. The actual payout script and amount are compared with the body. Positive remaining requires an exact same-tail reserve successor plus one payout; terminal zero requires only the payout.

checks.property: native current state and single-spend checks
checks.result: The old state is read from the spending redeem script and compared with the body; the current physical outpoint is checked. Exit preserves exact CM root/count and proves indexed-NF nonmembership/insertion natively using old root, canonical predecessor interval, authenticated empty append slot and exact new root/count.

The direct statement binds new domain, current CM root, original NF, SHA256 of exact native effects plus the entire exit body, payout and fee. Two exact 128-bit little-endian digest limbs are passed to the pinned native Groth16 verifier; no shared outer proof or MPC is required.

Canonical fixed input SPK is 37 bytes. A mixed continuation has a 193-byte prefix; direct continuing exit 240; terminal P2PK payout 192. The exit body is 1632 bytes and the payout SPK is 36 bytes. Effects exclude witness proof bytes; the mixed journal includes all body proof bytes.
